g.text: open_ticket(price, payout_table, app_share_bps, nonce), integrator-signed
Who is calling
integrator_authority signed: a program's PDA or a key
record [integrator, signer] found, or created now
refused · unsigned, or new records paused
Is the game fair
declared margin ≥ 100 vault + 20 protocol + app share
1 to 32 outcomes · Σp = 10⁹ exactly · every m ≤ 10 000×
Σ p·m ≤ (10 000 − margin) · 10⁹, in exact u128
refused · MarginFloor, or a bad payout table
Is the ticket sized right
ticket price between 7.5 and 10 000 USDC
liability = payout_max − vault_credit ≤ min(½·vault_margin·free, 150 bps·assets)
integrator's open liability ≤ 20 % of assets
refused · too small, too big, or over a cap
Can the vault take it
gross solvency: reserved + open vault credits ≤ assets
utilisation < 70 % · global exposure ≤ κ = 0.8
drawdown below 15 % over the last 24 h
refused · vault full, or a breaker tripped
Is it paid for
oracle fee and crank fee prepaid in SOL
refused · nobody would be paid to advance it
ACCEPT
ticket price escrowed · liability reserved · rules frozen into the ticket
Every check runs inside open_ticket, before a token moves; a refused ticket leaves no state behind.
Settlement re-checks nothing: it pays exactly what was accepted, under the rules frozen at open.
